admission.justification: Host publication/intake, native state selection, hierarchy joining, wire/store shape and task presentation jointly prevent a second task truth. Correct words over a competing collection, or a canonical map fed stale/unqualified host facts, cannot establish the guarantee. This proposed cross-boundary family leaves the approved Operations family and all its eight members untouched.

guarantee: A task has one qualified server entry and one browser task map: native document stage has precedence, bound host observations supply only started-task activity and event time, declared reciprocal rows and commanded relations supply ordered membership independently of worktrees, and task surfaces format that same state through the shared presentation table. Startup/new-boot reconciliation qualifies host activity while idle/full-heal/degraded wakes do not turn into status polling. Optional summaries, on-demand document bodies, dependency readiness and independent operational projections are not competing task truth. Display age is derived from eventAt and a display clock, not a second served elapsed-age value. Native start and abandon publish task/parent stage through the existing task-fact transaction, attach retains stage, and finalize/reopen retain their distinct authority. Task-source/contract publication rollback is not restoration of already-reclaimed worktrees.
